subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the given idiom.

Call it a day

options.text: Involve many people for a simple job

solution:
The correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Stop working on something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The idiom **"Call it a day"** means to stop working on something, usually because the work is complete or it is time to stop. (काम करना बंद कर देना)

 
 
• **Example: **After finishing the report, she decided to call it a day and went home.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 1** i.e. Stop working on something.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **Begin with an assignment **(किसी कार्य को शुरू करना): To start working on a specific task or project.

 
 
• **Example:** She began with an assignment that was due next week.
 
 
 
• **Name a particular day **(किसी विशेष दिन का नाम लेना): To mention or identify a specific day.
 
 
• **Example: **He named the particular day when the event would take place.
 
 
 
• **Involve many people for a simple job **(एक साधारण काम के लिए कई लोगों को शामिल करना): To engage more people than necessary for a straightforward task.
 
 
• **Example:** They involved many people for a simple job, making it more complicated than it needed to be.
